This [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''lichen''' grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] in the [[Dromund system]]. It thrived in gloomy conditions, growing on stone and it gave off a faint purple glow. During the [[Old Republic era|time period]] in which the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]] held Dromund Kaas as its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] the [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] was considered rare. At this time, [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Nyriss|Nyriss]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and member of the [[Dark Council]], used the lichen to decorate the courtyard of her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|stronghold]], where it was planted in decorative patterns amongst white stone pebbles. The Sith Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Darth Scourge]] noted the lichens presence when he was summoned to the stronghold by Nyriss in [[3956 BBY]] to investigate attempts on her life.

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species of lichen first appeared in the first chapter of [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s novel [[The Old Republic: Revan]] in which it was given no official name but simply described from [[Scourge (Sith)|Darth Scourge]], one of the Dramatis personage's, point of view.
